purpose: Adversarially audit only the frozen validated Codex result, waiver-aware comparison and synthesis plan without acquiring new research facts.
post_audit_holds: Claude and Grok absence remains visible and confidence remains medium.
Trace graph, query, result, snapshot and chain-of-custody claim remain distinct semantic kinds.
WM-FLW-004 parentage remains under review and WM-ACT-015 composition is typed event reference only.
Objects, events, movements, parties, places, handovers, documents, credentials, recalls, claims and evidence remain external masters.
Physical segregation, controlled blending, mass balance and book-and-claim remain profile-discriminated.
Custody, possession, control, responsibility and ownership cannot be inferred from one another.
Integrity proof and verification do not by themselves prove real-world truth or authority.
Every external projection remains version-pinned, access-controlled and loss-declaring.
audit_findings: The pattern preserves stable graph and result identity, semantic kind, scope, revision and successor lineage.
Traceable objects, events, aggregation, transformation, locations, parties and custody use typed time-qualified edges.
Event, effective, observation, record, ingestion, publication and correction clocks remain independent.
Gaps, duplicates, conflicts, error declarations and competing assertions remain visible rather than last-write-wins.
Backward and forward query results declare graph horizon, source freshness, omissions and residual uncertainty.
Exposure analysis remains separate from recall, certification and enforcement decisions.
Protected graph projections and privileged mutation are deny-by-default and purpose-bound.
No unresolved critical semantic conflict prevents reviewable-draft publication.
